params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $repo="$env:USERPROFILE\mhw-mods-work-canonical"; $wt="$env:USERPROFILE\mhw-mods-pr90-integration"; $branch='integration/pr90-reconcile-20260929'; if(Test-Path $wt){ throw "worktree path already exists: $wt" }; git -C $repo fetch --prune origin; git -C $repo worktree add -b $branch $wt origin/agent/game-profile-id-containment-v8.8.5-reconcile; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'worktree add failed' }; Push-Location $wt; try { git merge --no-commit --no-ff origin/main; $mergeCode=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output "MERGE_EXIT=$mergeCode"; Write-Output 'STATUS_BEGIN'; git status --short; Write-Output 'STATUS_END'; Write-Output 'CONFLICTS_BEGIN'; git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U; Write-Output 'CONFLICTS_END'; Write-Output 'MERGE_DIFFSTAT_BEGIN'; git diff --stat; Write-Output 'MERGE_DIFFSTAT_END'; Write-Output "HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"; Write-Output "MAIN=$(git rev-parse origin/main)" } finally { Pop-Location }
